components.name: Bottom navigation
components.description: Mobile bottom navigation with 3–5 destinations built from Bottom nav item. Each item is exposed: set its Label, Icon (any BEK - Icons style; Solid for the selected item), State and Badge directly. Style: Bar (edge to edge) or Floating (pill above content).

components.name: Bottom nav item
components.description: Single destination in Bottom navigation. Icon accepts any BEK - Icons style (Stroke Standard by default); use the Solid style for the Selected state. Badge: None, Dot (new content) or Count (number, max "99+"). Width fills the bar; min target 48.
